text:
Priya: quick QA note from mobile: when the topbar compacts on scroll and the left sidebar toggles, the table header ends up getting clipped under the global topbar. on iPhone the safe-area inset also gives a weird 8px offset. any preferred pattern?

Sam: seen that. root causes: stacking context from transforms + not using env(safe-area-inset-top). also the soft keyboard overlaps the fixed bottom action bar when editing a cell.

Lina: for the header: use position:sticky + explicit top that accounts for the global toolbar + safe-area. e.g. top: calc(var(--topbar-height) + env(safe-area-inset-top)); z-index high enough. for the nav animation, avoid using transform on the element that creates a new stacking context for the header.

Marco: quick idea: animate a visual overlay (crossfade/translate) for the sliding effect but keep the nav's layout width stable (clip the inner content). that keeps the header stacking intact while delivering the same motion.

Sam: good call. also prefer animating inner-wrapper width (or max-width) while outer rail stays in place but pointer-events:none when collapsed. helps keyboard and focus flows.

Lina: CSS snippet prototype: 
```
:root { --topbar-height: 56px; }
.header { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--topbar-height) + env(safe-area-inset-top)); z-index: 100; }
.left-rail { width: 240px; }
.left-rail__inner { width: 240px; transition: width .16s ease; overflow: hidden; }
.left-rail__inner.collapsed { width: 0; }
```
Also include prefers-reduced-motion and will-change where appropriate.

accessibility-bot: accessibility notes: 1) announce layout changes: "Sidebar collapsed" via aria-live polite; 2) set aria-hidden=true on collapsed nav and aria-expanded on the toggle; 3) on collapse move focus to main heading (tabindex=-1 then focus()) to avoid focus loss.

Priya: copy suggestions: change tooltip to "Collapse sidebar" (not "Hide nav"); overflow button currently says "More" in some spots and "More columns" in others 6 standardize to "Show columns". truncation: use ellipsis visible in UI but ensure full text presented in aria-label.

Sam: QA reported accidental sidebar collapse while swiping rows for actions. decision: restrict swipe-to-collapse to nav edge only and require a 30-40% horizontal threshold; row swipe gestures keep precedence inside table rows. maybe provide an explicit small drag-handle for discovery.

Marco: keyboard shortcut idea: allow Cmd/Ctrl+B to toggle nav; make sure toggle is reachable via keyboard and has aria-pressed. also add a focus-visible style for the collapsed state.

Lina: remember to test with notch and different status bar heights; safe-area env varies by device. also test with onscreen keyboard so bottom toolbar uses env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

Marco: I'll prototype the overlay+inner-wrapper approach and include the safe-area calc + a short test plan (iOS Safari, Android Chrome, low-end devices). will open a small PR and link it here.

Priya: great 1 I'll update Figma micro-interactions: collapse handle, threshold, tooltip copy, and keyboard shortcut. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
